milestones.title: The global archive goes live
milestones.summary: The public SpicyChat Archive starts as a global bot-history project with scheduled scans, multiple public listings, deep catalog discovery, deleted-bot preservation, tag filtering and image archiving.

milestones.title: The first broad discovery proves the scale
milestones.summary: The first crawl finds roughly 9,000 bots, then another roughly 2,000. SpicyChat's Typesense index is already reporting about 1.39 million public results, so discovery is expanded from 8 to 20 deep-search pages per run.
milestones.totalLabel: roughly discovered by the first two scans

milestones.title: The archive moves to Cloudflare R2
milestones.summary: The first R2 migration uploads 11,269 bot records plus the existing ranking history, moving the growing per-bot archive out of Git while keeping the public website lightweight.

milestones.title: Post-migration crawling is working
milestones.summary: A successful R2-backed crawl reaches about 12,400 archived records, adds 937 new bots, refreshes 199 of 200 full-detail checks and saves 100 of 100 queued images.

milestones.title: Discovery is rebuilt to scale
milestones.summary: Sharded discovery lands with a 100-page baseline, larger healthy-run ramps, parallel page prefetch, locator indexes and journaled R2 state so the crawler can work toward the million-plus catalog without turning Git into the database.
